message: The `multipart/form-data` request body schema extends "Named" through an `allOf` `$ref`. Request body extensions are not supported for file upload (multipart) requests, so Fern drops the properties inherited from "Named". Declare them directly in the request body schema instead.

The `multipart/form-data` request body schema extends "Described" through an `allOf` `$ref`. Request body extensions are not supported for file upload (multipart) requests, so Fern drops the properties inherited from "Described". Declare them directly in the request body schema instead.
